value: less-developed visual streak; peak ganglion cell density 2250 per mm2
method: ganglion cell counts in whole-mounted retinae (as reported in the abstract)

source.authors: Silveira LCL, Picanço-Diniz CW, Oswaldo-Cruz E
source.title: Distribution and size of ganglion cells in the retinae of large Amazon rodents

note: Abstract on the Cambridge page only; full text purchase unavailable. The abstract says 'capybara'; the species name Hydrochoerus hydrochaeris is from the 2022 UFPA thesis by Sampaio that reports on the same three rodents.
